cues: An analogue signal varies continuously, like a voice.
A digital signal jumps between levels for nought and one.
Noise on an analogue signal piles up for good, while a digital signal can be regenerated perfectly.
text: A signal represents data physically. An analogue signal varies continuously, like a voice. A digital signal jumps between levels for nought and one. Noise on an analogue signal piles up for good, while a digital signal can be regenerated perfectly.
